title: Introduce cooperative runloop, occupancy probe, and lightweight KV lease contract
creator: Rohan Patel
description:
Background: Over time the continuous-batching code-path has accumulated several heavy-weight coordination primitives (global epoch locks, heavyweight lease heartbeats, and a blocking io/worker handoff). These have been repeatedly identified in p99 tail latency and allocation flamegraphs for multi-tenant high-throughput workloads. Goal: remove a class of blocking coordination from the hot path by introducing a cooperative runloop for slot/worker occupancy, a lightweight occupancy probe to proactively prime slots, and an epochless KV lease contract that reduces cross-shard coordination. This ticket implements the refactor, smoothing migration compatibility, and validating performance improvements across representative workloads.

Scope and non-goals:
- In scope: implement cooperative runloop on scheduler side, occupancy probe API for pre-warm, define and implement an epochless KV lease (lease id + incarnation monotonic counter) and the migration shim between old lease heartbeats and the new contract, add telemetry and dashboards for occupancy and lease churn, unit and e2e tests, and a canary rollout plan.
- Out of scope: full rewrite of the batcher state machine or model-serving allocator; changes to admission control token model; quantization/runtime kernel changes. Those are follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: No global epoch lock is taken on the hot enqueue path in perf builds (verified by code inspection and CI assertion)
p99 tail latency reduces by >=15% on the 90th percentile tenant in our synthetic RLHF-ish workload (compare before/after runs in perf-staging)
KV lease churn (number of lease revocations per minute) decreases by at least 30% under steady-state multi-tenant traffic
Occupancy probe reduces cold-start slots by 40% for bursty traffic traces in the prewarm experiment
Backward-compatible migration shim in place so older Dedicated workers can still accept leases during rollout
Comprehensive unit tests for lease contract semantics and integration test that simulates shard rebinds and leader handoff
Documentation updated: Confluence design doc, and runtime-1.22 release notes reference
Feature gated and rolled out via canary routing with an automatic rollback on error budget regression
notes: 2026-02-10 - created by Rohan Patel: initial problem statement and perf targets pulled from 2026-01 perf triage.

2026-02-16 - design review with infra & runtime: agreed on cooperative runloop (single-thread per-core event loop) to avoid mutexes on enqueue. Action: prototype occupancy_probe API (fetch slot hint + prewarm) and draft lease contract.

2026-02-22 - prototype landed: small prototype in feature branch that replaces epoch lock with per-shard lightweight sequence and a TryAcquireLease fast-path (no syscall on hit). Early perf: xalloc flamegraphs show reduced contention on global lock.
2026-02-28 - PM feedback (Maya Li): ensure migration shim includes telemetry for mixed-version clusters and add an operator command to accelerate migration if needed.
2026-03-02 - Security review requested: no direct customer data changes; KV lease metadata is non-sensitive. Security signoff planned after PR.

2026-03-05 - QA findings: race in simulated shard failover where occupancy probe could over-allocate slots if rebind occurs mid-probe. Added mitigation: probe token with short TTL and post-probe reconciler.
2026-03-08 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/11234. Patch adds runloop, occupancy probe, lease contract, and feature gate runtime.coop_runloop

2026-03-10 - Perf runs started in perf-staging. Preliminary numbers: median latency unchanged, p95 improves ~8%, p99 improves ~12% on read-heavy traces. Need another tuning iteration to hit p99 target.

2026-03-12 - Engineering sync: split remaining work into two sub-tasks: stabilize probe reconciliation (ENG-314272) and extend telemetry for per-tenant lease churn (ENG-314273). Planning to land runloop + lease contract behind gate for limited canary on 2026-03-20.
implementation_plan: 1) Prototype cooperative runloop and TryAcquireLease fast-path in a feature branch
2) Add occupancy_probe API and reconciler with TTL-based probe tokens
3) Implement epochless lease contract with incarnation counter and revocation marker
4) Add migration shim for mixed clusters and feature-gate behavior
5) Add telemetry, dashboards, and CI assertions for no-epoch-lock on hot-path
6) Canary rollout to 10% of traffic, monitor error budget and latency, roll forward or back
7) Post-rollout: iterate on probe heuristics and bake into runtime-1.22 release
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: subtle lease invariant violation during aggressive failover could cause duplicate slot assignment. Mitigation: instrument invariant checks, add reactor test that simulates split-brain and force rollback path.
Risk: occupancy probe over-priming wastes GPU time under miscalibrated heuristics. Mitigation: conservative default probe budget per-tenant + adaptive scaling based on recent eviction rate.
Risk: migration complexity in Dedicated (mixed-version) clusters. Mitigation: operator tool to opt-in, and safety flag that prevents cross-shard auto-reclaim until all nodes are upgraded.
Risk: increased code complexity in scheduler. Mitigation: keep cooperative runloop small and well-documented, and provide a fallback path to legacy scheduler guarded by runtime.coop_runloop=false
